title: Tutor figure
description: The one figure block the live tutor may write in a reply (docs/agent/drawing-design.md, The figure language). The model writes shapes, numbers and expressions; the server computes every point. Semantic rules a schema cannot state (unique ids, references to earlier elements, fade and erase of earlier steps, ordered windows, spans, the 16-element cap) are checked in app/agent/drawing/spec.py.
